info.name: Nextdesk
info.summary: Your Nextdesk remote Linux desktop, embedded inside Nextcloud
info.description:
Adds a Nextdesk icon to the Nextcloud app menu that opens your Nextdesk remote-desktop instance inside Nextcloud's own page shell (via an iframe). Nextdesk must already be deployed separately and configured to accept this Nextcloud instance as its OIDC identity provider — see Nextdesk's own docs/auth-setup.md for that half of the setup, and this app's README for the Nextcloud-side wiring (admin URL + CSP/frame headers).
Because the desktop is a third-party iframe, some browsers' third-party cookie restrictions (Safari ITP, Chrome's phase-out) can interfere with keeping the embedded session logged in — see the README before relying on this for end users on those browsers.
